name: Disable Clouds on the Overview Map
description: Hides the clouds that drift over the island on the overview map (the Map button): they are not drawn at all, so the whole island shows. Only the overview map changes: the village, its weather and every other screen look exactly as before, and the map's markers, buttons and its fade when you leave it are unchanged. **On by default.** **Needs no other patch.** **With this on, the clouds are hidden, so the game's own push (the clouds moving away from the cursor) has no visible effect until this is unticked.** **Not yet seen in a running game** (checked by emulation of the stock executable).
behavior_changes: The overview screen's draw slot 0x448510 draws its five clouds (map_cloud01.png and cloud variations1-3.png (sprites 0x99..0x9C), alpha each cloud's own) in the loop 0x448623..0x44865B; the loop is skipped: lea ebp, [esi+0xAC] becomes xor ebx, ebx / jmp 0x44865B (two nops after it, never reached): the code after the loop compares the screen's two leaving bytes with bl, which the stock loop leaves at 0. No cloud is drawn on the overview map.
explicit_non_changes: Only the overview screen's own draw routine changes; the sprite draw routine, the cloud pictures and every other screen (the village view, its fog and weather, the title screen) are the game's own.

The clouds' positions, drift and wrap are still updated every frame as before; nothing is written to a save, a villager record or a file. The game's own push of the clouds away from the cursor (0x447CC0) still moves them; with nothing drawn it cannot be seen.

patches.purpose: the overview map's cloud loop 0x448623: lea ebp, [esi+0xAC] becomes xor ebx, ebx / jmp 0x44865B (two nops after it, never reached): the code after the loop compares the screen's two leaving bytes with bl, which the stock loop leaves at 0
